purpose: Planning fixture only; not live customer data

change_request.title: Allow limited automatic shipping replies
change_request.proposed_change: Allow the assistant to send routine shipping-status replies automatically only after successful order lookup. Refund requests and account-security requests must still be reviewed and sent by a support agent. If order lookup fails or intent is uncertain, route the draft for human review. Keep the billing receipt service unchanged.
protected_constraints: Missing order data or uncertain intent requires human review.
The separate billing receipt service is unchanged.
change_request.boundary_note: This is a proposed change for planning review. It does not authorize sending messages or changing a real product.

sections.text: The assistant drafts responses for a support agent. Every customer-facing answer requires approval by a support agent before sending.
The product supports shipping-status questions, refund requests, and account-security questions.
A support agent remains accountable for customer-facing response policy. Changes to automation require product and engineering review.
Every generated response appears in the agent review queue. The send control remains disabled until a support agent chooses Approve.
The interface shows the customer question, generated draft, and linked order information when available.
The outbound worker rejects every customer-support message when approval_id is missing.
Successful order lookup returns delivery_status and order_id. A failed lookup returns ORDER_NOT_FOUND.
The response record stores request_id, response_id, approval_id, and sent_at.
Given any support request, when approval_id is absent, then sending must fail.
Given a refund request, the response is sent only after a support agent approves it.
Given an account-security request, the response is sent only after a support agent approves it.
Every response_sent event requires reviewer_id. Events without reviewer_id are rejected.
Current reporting measures approval-to-send time for all responses. The event has no field describing whether the response was sent automatically or reviewed by a human.
Refund responses must be approved and sent by a support agent. The assistant must not authorize or issue a refund.
Account-security responses require support-agent approval before sending. Identity-verification steps are unchanged.
Automatically send invoice receipts after successful payment. This billing service is separate from customer-support messages.
Receipt delivery records contain payment_id and receipt_id. No support-agent approval is required.
